interpretation.incident_success: Calibrated hysteresis generalized: median fragmentation is one incident per true event, mean 1.10, max 3, with low nuisance burden. The operator paging problem exposed by Hanoi-001/002 is substantially resolved.
interpretation.detection: Fresh-start recall is 62.1%, but an incident covers the first five hours of 75.9% of leak events. Eventual incident detection is 84.5%.
interpretation.localization_failure: The static one-shot localizer is now the limiting subsystem. Conditional top-three localization among early-covered events fell to 52.3% on this cohort even though incident handling stabilized.
interpretation.architectural_lesson: Localization should be treated as a continuously refreshable belief inside an open incident, not a ranking frozen when the incident first opens. This matters especially when an incident predates a later leak or the hydraulic signature evolves.
interpretation.next_iteration: Keep detector and incident hysteresis fixed. Expand localization training with burned Hanoi events, refresh localization rankings periodically while incidents remain active, and test time-to-top3 on a fresh sealed Hanoi cohort.
